Reusable dispatch-prompt skeletons for READ-ONLY audit/synthesis lanes (parallel
docs-only workers). Copy, fill placeholders, write to a temp/run-dir file, dispatch with:
  PROMPT=$(cat <prompt-file>) && "<hermes.exe>" chat -q "$PROMPT" --provider <p> --model <m> \
    --yolo --pass-session-id --checkpoints --max-turns 200 --source cli \
    > <run-dir>/manager/dispatch-<lane>.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?" >> <run-dir>/manager/dispatch-<lane>.log
mkdir -p the log's parent FIRST. Observed working instance: S13-P00 A/B/C/D, run 20260823-0045-r1.

=== Skeleton 1: audit lane (one of N disjoint read-only auditors) ===
HARD WORKTREE GUARD: Before ANY action, run and verify from your shell cwd:
1. pwd -> must be <WORKTREE>
2. git rev-parse --show-toplevel -> must equal that path
3. git branch --show-current -> <BRANCH>
4. git rev-parse HEAD -> record the value you see (pin it in your LOG)
5. git status --porcelain | wc -l -> snapshot count in your LOG
If (1)(2)(3) differ: write NOTHING anywhere, report BLOCKED: WRONG_WORKTREE and stop.

TASK ID: <ID> - <lane title> (READ-ONLY audit worker).
You are a documentation auditor. You produce analysis documents ONLY. You do NOT write code,
tests, migrations, UI or config. You do NOT call any external service. Manager and Codex
Reviewer will adversarially verify every citation.

EXCLUSIVE WRITE ALLOWLIST: output/<run-id>/lane-<x>/ (create it with mkdir -p on first write).
FORBIDDEN WRITES (absolute): app/**, frontend/**, tests/**, alembic migrations, fixtures,
channels.json, data/**, docs/** (including docs/pm), <MAIN tree>, any other worktree,
other lanes' output dirs, any file outside your lane directory. NEVER: commit/push/merge/
reset/restore/checkout/clean/stash/delete, pip/npm installs, network calls, provider/API
calls, model downloads, database creation (<DB_ENV_VAR> stays UNSET - never set it).

REQUIRED READING (in order; read-only; cite what you actually saw):
R1..Rn. <planning docs + concrete repo paths/grep hints; absence of an expected doc = record UNKNOWN>

OUTCOME - define, grounded ONLY in R1-Rn evidence:
O1..Om. <contract/boundary/matrix the lane must produce>
<For contract lanes: For EVERY proposed field/state define owner | authority | idempotency | audit rule.
For matrix lanes: classify EVERY row EXISTING (cite file:symbol) / PROPOSED / UNKNOWN (say what resolves it).>

DELIVERABLES (all inside lane-<x>/):
- <named acceptance docs>
- LOG.md (timestamped +07 progress entries, guard results, reading checklist, self-audit)
- REPORT.md ends with a Self-Audit section: list EVERY path you created (must all be under
  your lane dir), attest zero writes elsewhere, attest no network/DB/provider usage,
  then final line exactly: STATUS: TASK_SUBMITTED

CITATION DISCIPLINE: every claim cites real file:symbol or doc section you opened this
session. NEVER fabricate existing code, symbols, APIs or quotes. Proposals marked PROPOSED.
Contradictions recorded with both citations.
Stop after STATUS: TASK_SUBMITTED and exit.

=== Skeleton 2: synthesis lane (runs AFTER all audit lanes verified) ===
Same GUARD / ALLOWLIST / FORBIDDEN blocks, plus:
- Owner rule: session NEW - do not reuse any prior session.
- lane-a/, lane-b/, lane-c/ are READ-ONLY for you.
INPUT SOURCES: the verified lane dirs + each lane REPORT.md + <canonical roadmap/planning>.
Citation format: [A:<doc> <section/row>], [B:...], [C:...], [S2 <section>] - every
substantive claim MUST trace to a lane or planning source.
OUTCOME: EXACTLY these deliverables D1..D7:
D1 READINESS_REPORT.md (verdict; label FACT / INFERENCE / PROPOSAL throughout)
D2 DEPENDENCY_DAG.md (every edge justified by a finding)
D3 WRITESET_MATRIX.md (per future task: exclusive paths, forbidden paths, overlap risks;
   concurrent foreign lanes attributed, never assumed free)
D4 TASK_MAP_<range>_DRAFT.md (each task session-sized: outcome/deps/write-set/forbidden/
   binary AC/evidence; ASSUMPTIONS register; whole doc PROPOSAL)
D5 ACCEPTANCE_GATES.md (per task: suites, checks, scenario IDs, metrics, evidence Codex demands)
D6 RISK_REGISTER.md (likelihood/impact/mitigation/owner)
D7 OPEN_PRODUCT_DECISIONS.md (every cross-lane contradiction resolved PUBLICLY: both sides +
   resolution + rationale; every UNKNOWN carried unhidden; decisions only BA/Codex can make)
RULES: if checking one disputed code fact, grep read-only and cite file:symbol; record
repo-vs-lane discrepancies (lanes ran hours ago; other writers move the tree meanwhile).
Same LOG.md / REPORT.md Self-Audit / STATUS: TASK_SUBMITTED tail.
